messages:
maria: Quick runbook check — Launch window for Marketplace listing: 2026-05-12 10:00 PT. Need confirmation on press embargo, SI onboarding, and hardware badge delivery. TL;DR: what are blockers?

jordan: Onboarding docs for SI in staging are 90% — one missing example for SSO. I'll push a patch by EOD.

alex: Press asset status: landing copy + hero is ready. Need final legal copy by Thu COB. Marketing will schedule publish for 10:05 PT (5 min after listing) to avoid race conditions.

raj: Runtime team flagged a gating item: marketplace image for model variant needs a 2GB reduction for filesystem constraints. Asking HW partner for a smaller artifact. ETA 48h.

sophia: Legal: embargo ok, but need final partner attribution sentence for partner marketplace listing. Send the exact line for signoff.

deploy-bot: [deploy] marketplace-catalog:v3 staged to staging-eu at 2026-04-22T15:12:02Z

jordan: @sophia I'll DM the attribution sentence. Also, SI onboarding runbook link: https://redwood.dev/si/onboarding-runbook

maria: Proposed fallback if HW artifact not ready: publish metadata without image and add image in a patch 24h later. Thoughts?

raj: Agree — fallback works. But we need temporary note in landing page: "Image rolling update in progress" to avoid support tickets.

alex: Marketing ok with placeholder, but need approval on copy. Proposed text: "Visual asset coming within 24 hours — full listing live now." @sophia ok?

sophia: Fine. Please send final copy. Also confirm there's no partner embargo clause forbidding placeholder.

jordan: I can wire the placeholder into the CDN edge rule. Whoever owns infra, ping @eng-infra for a fast route.

maria: Action items:
- Raj: smaller artifact or confirm placeholder by 4/24 12:00 PT
- Jordan: hook CDN placeholder and SI runbook updates by 4/24 EOD
- Alex: final marketing copy + publish cadence by 4/23 COB
- Sophia: legal signoff on partner attribution and placeholder by 4/23 COB

Please react with :white_check_mark: when you have the item.

raj: :white_check_mark: pushing compressed artifact now.

alex: :white_check_mark: copy in #marketing-assets

sophia: :white_check_mark: legal cleared partner sentence

jordan: :white_check_mark: CDN rule in place — will monitor post-launch logs

maria: Great — last ask: any risk of international embargo mismatch? @partners-ops please confirm region PR timings.

partners-ops-bot: Region publish schedule: NA 10:00 PT, EU 18:00 CEST, APAC 09:00 JST. Staggered publishes enabled.

maria: Perfect. Closing this thread — final sync tomorrow 08:30 PT for preflight. If anything blocks before then, post here.

alex: Noted. Thanks all :rocket:
